crux: which pixel extent is the width: eave-level y extent of the top-down roof (618 px, shorter side) vs the 805 px cross-gable ridge-level x extent (longer side)
fault_found: C2/C3 used the 805 px x extent measured only at the cross-gable ridge row (eave-level 699 px, inflated ~1.15x by ridge height) along the longer side; the submitted blend carries 30 pct of it
lesson: In a top-down render, a roof outline's farthest points are ridge ends pushed radially outward by their height; read footprint extents at the eave corners, and take width as the shorter of the two eave-level extents.
